Rewards

100 points = $1 Redeem anytime as a discount on any service
  • Earn as you spend Earn 2 points for every $1 spent, based on the actual amount paid.
  • Refer a new client Earn 300 points ($3) for every new client you successfully refer. There is no referral limit.
  • Gift card purchase bonuses Buy a gift card and earn bonus points for yourself:
    $50 → 300 pts $100 → 800 pts $200 → 2,000 pts $300 → 3,500 pts
  • Birthday month bonus Receive 500 bonus points during your birthday month, once per year.
  • 12-month expiration Each group of points expires 12 months after the date it was earned.

Keep your nails looking fresh

  • Apply cuticle oil daily to keep nails and skin hydrated.
  • Wear gloves for cleaning, dishes, and harsh chemicals.
  • Use tools—not your nails—to open cans, packages, or lids.
  • If you notice lifting or a chip, contact us before it gets worse.
